## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated generated or build
      output.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the PR explains why tests are unnecessary.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and public APIs are documented.
- [ ] Format, manifest, and CLI changes update their canonical specifications or
      references.
- [ ] Default and `--auto` builds still preserve every usable feature; any data
      reduction is explicit and reported.
- [ ] New animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] I checked for credentials, private URLs, and confidential data.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are clearly identified.
